issues.legal_issue: Persons present during a killing are not constructively liable for murder unless evidence connects the killer’s act to their shared intention or the assembly’s common object.
material_facts: The accused were present when one person stabbed the deceased, but the evidence did not establish that they shared an intention to kill or that killing was the assembly’s common object.
The earlier dispute could have prompted a confrontation or quarrel, but did not establish a plan to commit murder.
There was no evidence that the other accused knew the assailant was carrying a knife; they had no weapons, and the assailant inflicted a single stab without a further attack.
Witnesses described other accused restraining the deceased and witnesses, but those details were absent from the initial report, and the witnesses differed about who had restrained whom.
issues.conclusion: The evidence did not establish that the assailant’s act was in furtherance of a common intention or in prosecution of a common object. The convictions for constructive liability for murder were set aside, and the appellants were acquitted.
issues.legal_principle: Under Sections 34 and 149 of the Indian Penal Code, proof that every accused personally committed an overt act is not necessary for constructive liability. However, there must be material showing that the act of one or more accused was done in furtherance of the common intention of all, or in prosecution of the common object of the unlawful assembly. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: constructive_murder_conviction_appeal and accused_present_at_killing and individual_assailant_committed_stabbing and (not evidence_of_shared_murder_intention or not evidence_of_murder_as_common_object)

predicates.constructive_murder_conviction_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal by persons convicted of murder on the basis of shared intention or an assembly’s common object.
predicates.accused_present_at_killing: The accused were present when another person killed the victim.
predicates.individual_assailant_committed_stabbing: One individual assailant inflicted a stab wound that caused the victim’s death.
predicates.evidence_of_shared_murder_intention: The evidence shows that the accused shared an intention to kill the victim.
predicates.evidence_of_murder_as_common_object: The evidence shows that killing the victim was the assembly’s common object.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns constructive murder liability for accused present at a killing by an individual, that liability is not established if the evidence fails to show either a shared intention to murder or murder as the assembly’s common object.
